title: O3K native image upload action v1
description: The action request body is raw bounded image bytes, not JSON. The HTTP Content-Type MUST be application/octet-stream. This schema is the machine-readable description of the byte stream; the bytes are validated by the image authority.
$comment: POST /o3k/v1/image/images/{id}/actions/UploadImage with Idempotency-Key and application/octet-stream. The native router bounds the body to 1048576 bytes in the portable profile; deployment-specific lower bounds remain valid. No caller-supplied owner, resource ID, provider ID, or operation ID is accepted.
